reason: Adds Work-mode file browsing, file and image previews, and a persistent shell terminal in resizable side panels, with conversation-scoped host routes and optional remote workspace support.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的 Work 模式添加可调整大小的文件浏览器与持久终端面板，并提供工作区文件预览和会话范围的主机访问。
summaries.en: Adds resizable Work-mode file explorer and persistent terminal panels to DeepSeek Harness with workspace previews and conversation-scoped host access.

capabilities: Provides a file explorer for the conversation workspace
Reads text files and serves workspace images for preview
Opens a persistent shell per conversation through a WebSocket terminal
Adds resizable Work-mode side panels and header controls
Supports local or remote workspace access through an optional remote-development service
